svg.title: PiPER Active-View Scanning: Detailed System Architecture
svg.desc: Implementation map for main plus the explicitly labelled cuRobo integration path
svg.text: PiPER Active-View Scanning: Detailed System Architecture
Implementation map for main plus the explicitly labelled cuRobo integration path

g.text: 1 Mission request and frozen operator intent
External task ownership; the tracked base is never commanded here.
One coordinator, one process generation and one autonomous command owner.
3 Eye-in-hand sensing, perception and measured scene state
Only timestamp-correlated measurements become target or scene evidence.
Prediction may rank a view; it never becomes measured reconstruction input.
5 Frozen motion-planner backend and command-free proposal
Tesseract is on main; cuRobo is explicitly branch-only and hardware-unqualified.
6 Common authorization, execution and physical feedback
Every backend must traverse the same fail-closed execution boundary.
7 Settled observation, immutable commit and closed-loop feedback
Accepted and rejected observations deliberately have different state effects.
8 Terminal safety, tracked-base correlation and reconstruction
Reconstruction begins only from immutable data after the required safe-state evidence.

text.tspan: motor loss: no further motion command
fault can restart owned vision stack
freezes tesseract or curobo per mission
camera clock, obstacles, hashes and views
joint order, finite values and times
arm result may wait for base home
repository still sends no chassis command
optional bounded GICP / scene pose graph
failure does not rewrite mission result

g.text: Command chain: planner proposal -> executor joint command -> PiPER driver CAN + feedback.
